title: OSF Identity appearance pack manifest
description: Optional package.json at the pack root. The containing folder name is the pack ID. Omit assignments to discover presets from <OwningPlugin>/<localFormId>.npc; add assignments only for custom preset paths.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to package.schema.json. OSF Identity does not load this URI at runtime.

priority.description: Conflict priority after validation. Higher values win; equal values use the case-insensitive pack folder name.

requires.description: Pack-wide dependencies. A missing entry disables the entire pack. Omit this property when there are none.

assignments.description: Explicit target-to-preset mappings. When omitted, OSF Identity scans <OwningPlugin>/<localFormId>.npc files instead.

target.description: Load-order-independent identity of the NPC base form.

plugin.description: Filename of the plugin that owns the NPC base. This plugin is also an implicit requirement.

preset.description: Path to a producer-exported .npc file, relative to the pack root.

requires.description: Dependencies for this assignment only. They are additive with pack-wide requirements.

plugin.description: An ESM, ESP, or ESL filename without directory separators or a drive prefix.

localFormId.description: One to eight hexadecimal digits, no 0x prefix, with a numeric value no greater than 00FFFFFF. The resolved plugin tier may impose a lower limit.

relativePath.description: A relative path without a drive prefix, leading separator, or parent traversal component.

plugins.description: Plugin filenames that must be loaded. Matching and duplicate detection are case-insensitive at runtime.

assets.description: Loose files that must exist beneath the Starfield Data directory. Matching and duplicate detection are case-insensitive at runtime.
